name: Financial Item 1
definition: Specifies information about a financing relation between two parties represented by a document, for example invoice, credit.|The component may include an external document describing details of the underlying trade object using an external schema.

ItemContext.name: Item Context
ItemContext.definition: Parameters identifying the context of the item.

FinancialDocumentReference.name: Financial Document Reference
FinancialDocumentReference.definition: Identifier of financial document that is the base document for this item, for example an invoice number.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the value is a debit or credit.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Specifies the total amount related to the financial document.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional proprietary textual information concerning the item.

AssociatedDocument.name: Associated Document
AssociatedDocument.definition: Associated free form document, for example a delivery confirmation.

FinancingStatus.name: Financing Status
FinancingStatus.definition: Financing status if applicable for the item.

ProprietaryDetails.name: Proprietary Details
ProprietaryDetails.definition: Structured proprietary information concerning details of the financial item.
